items.q: What limits how you build a huge agent-written project?
items.a: **How you verify it works**: the testing strategy should **pick the approach**, not the other way round.

items.q: Which tests can you trust after an agent rewrite?
items.a: Tests that **predate the project** and are in a **different language** from the code; once you **rewrite the tests** you can't trust them.

items.q: How did Bun check its ahead-of-time compiler?
items.a: Run apps **with the JIT, AOT-compiled and without types**, require **identical behaviour**, then **fuzz** with agent-written generators.

items.q: Why did the compiler get rewritten five times?
items.a: Versions were **bloated, sloppy or too slow to build**; before shipping, **rewriting beats refactoring**.

items.q: What does Jarred spend his day telling Claude?
items.a: 'Continue', **leading questions** and **'try harder'**, because models **make up rules** and settle for **0.1% gains instead of 10%**.

items.q: How do you keep track of a huge agent project?
items.a: An **hourly scorecard** of key metrics against the previous run, so **regressions stand out**.
